statements.statement: Resignation letter read into the record states the recent override failed
Member notes that even the balanced-budget option's own slide showed an override would still be needed in coming years
Board discusses whether to call a special town meeting to revisit and continue discussing the balanced budget, pending School Committee and Finance Committee input
